# debug\_getRawBlock

> [!NOTE]
> Served only when `debug` is named in `--http.api` or `--ws.api`; see [Enabling Namespaces](../enabling-namespaces.md).

Returns a whole block as RLP-encoded bytes.

#### Parameters

`block parameter`: `QUANTITY|TAG|DATA` \[_Required_] - Hexadecimal block number, or one of the string tags `latest`, `earliest`, `safe`, or `finalized`; a 32-byte block hash is also accepted. See the [default block parameter](https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/apis/json-rpc/#default-block).

#### Returns

`DATA` - The RLP-encoded block: the header, the transactions, the (empty) ommers list and the (empty) withdrawals list. A block the node does not have fails with error `-32001` and a message such as `block not found: 0x5` or `block not found: hash 0x…`.

#### Example

#### Request

```
curl http://localhost:8545 \
 -X POST \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"debug_getRawBlock","params":["0x1"],"id":1}'
```

#### Result

```
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": ""
}
```
